basis: All purchase percentages are fractions of initial capital P0, excluding emergency funds and fixed near-term spending. Market-value weights drift.

acceleration_proposal.reference: own rolling52week intraday high; same convention as daily report
acceleration_proposal.at15: One future monthly installment for that symbol can be advanced.
acceleration_proposal.at25: Cumulative advancement allowance rises to two monthly installments per symbol, inclusive of any advancement at15.
acceleration_proposal.one_time: Each allowance can be used only once during this initial build-up; no reset on reentry or a new high.
acceleration_proposal.skip: Remove advanced installments from the future calendar, do not buy them twice.
acceleration_proposal.cost_budget: VOO purchases at most30%P0; QQQM purchases at most10%P0.
acceleration_proposal.risk_override: Pause/add less if projected stock market-value weight would exceed45% or spending/risk capacity changes.

stress_assumptions: hypothetical arithmetic, not a historical backtest or prediction
defensive total return assumed0 only for the calculation
exclude FX, taxes and transaction costs; actual losses may be larger
account_status: No confirmed holdings or account action
automation_status: Existing daily automation and live alert state unchanged
